home_meta_title: Cafés and bars to work from

home_intro: Cafés and bars where you can work on your laptop, checked by people who work there.

action_zoom_out_certified: Zoom out to find certified places
place_meta_description_certified: {name} in {area} is certified for remote work. See Wi‑Fi, outlets, noise and laptop rules confirmed by users.
place_meta_description_community: Wi‑Fi, outlets, noise and laptop rules at {name} in {area}, shared by users who worked there.

preview_be_first: Be the first to check it

place_may_have_closed_body: It's no longer on OpenStreetMap. Check before you go.
error_not_found_body: The place may have been removed, or the link may be wrong.

auth_body_contribution: Your answers are saved. Signing in shows others who confirmed them. No password needed.

auth_code_sent_again: We sent a new code. Earlier codes no longer work.
auth_legal: By continuing you agree to the {terms} and {privacy}.
auth_error_wrong_code: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
auth_error_expired_code: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth_error_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth_error_google_cancelled: Google sign-in was canceled. Try again, or use your email.
auth_error_offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
auth_error_unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
profile_name_choice_body: Choose whether your first name appears on the places you update. You can change it later.
profile_name_choice_everywhere: This applies to all places, including updates you've already sent.
profile_name_hint: First name only, up to 30 characters.
profile_name_error_empty: Enter your first name, or choose to stay anonymous.
profile_name_error_invalid: Use your first name, not an email address.
profile_name_choice_required: Choose one of the two options.
email_signin_code_intro: Enter this code on the page where you asked to sign in:
email_signin_link_intro: Or sign in with one tap:

email_signin_ignore: If you didn't ask to sign in, you can ignore this email.

auth_error_wrong_code_latest: That code isn't right. Use the code from the most recent email.
auth_error_too_many_seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
